paragraphs: What is worth observing is the ability to understand different needs, organize the original expression, the existing plan and the new feedback, and then write the progress and the next step with a basis. The wish to help has to become action that is accurate, respectful and within the duties.

The work is not only face-to-face conversation but also plan review, documentation, team discussion and continuous follow-up. First check the service population, scheduling, supervision and recovery arrangements, and do not equate being willing to help with being able to take on every task.

This page uses the US SOC21-1018 combined category, which does not mean the three counselling directions have exactly the same tasks or entry requirements. The adjacent Chinese anti-drug social work sample also does not confer psychotherapy or diagnostic authority.

First complete the F1 fictional plan progress check: judge the eight statuses one by one, then revise the handover summary according to the two pieces of feedback in F2 and complete F3. Compare input and conclusion on paper only, without designing treatment, assessing real people or contacting institutions.
Which abilities should be verified first in order to understand counselling work further?

Observe the concrete behaviour of listening, plan records, status updates and accepting supervision. Being able to separate the goal, what has already happened and the arrangements still to be confirmed is a starting point for exploration; one fictional exercise cannot prove professional judgment or a practice licence.

The exploration prompt does not constitute a psychological diagnosis, an ability certification or a hiring judgment. Any real service requires checking the local law, the training level and the institutional responsibility.

Observable signals include: a willingness to understand the expression first rather than rushing to persuade; reading the plan and then still checking the latest records; being able to point out on receiving feedback whether the goal, the date, the status or the wording needs to change; and not writing an unanswered item as completed. When facing a task you have not been trained for, you can state it honestly and find the authorized responsible person, rather than promising an outcome to look capable.

First ask yourself whether you are willing to keep writing records, accept fluctuating progress, clarify the division of work in a team and arrange recovery under real conditions. Only wanting to give advice without reviewing the materials, or treating a service user's different choices as non-cooperation, is worth observing first through study and feedback. Strong interest also cannot let you ignore institutional scheduling, professional supervision and legal boundaries.

After completing the eight status judgments, the A and B versions of the summary and F3, choose one specific task that needs strengthening. The next step can be a proper course or supervised learning; one experience does not declare fit, treatment ability or a successful hire.

US BLS places substance abuse, behavioural disorder and mental health counsellors in the SOC21-1018 combined category. The wages and employment on this page follow that category, and the subdivided tasks refer to O*NET21-1011 and 21-1014; the full requirements of one direction cannot be treated as a common rule.

The input may include the person's own expression, existing records, service goals and team feedback. When understanding the need, you should be able to state who the information came from, when it was recorded and what remains to be confirmed; do not write a guess as a professional conclusion because the wording flows well.

BLS lists tasks such as developing, recommending and reviewing goal plans with the service user and family, and the actual method depends on training and licensing. Career exploration only compares whether the plan and progress wording correspond, and does not train readers to design a real treatment plan.

The main output includes the plan, progress records, resource contacts and stage linkage arrangements. The record should state not only what was done but also the unfinished parts, the review basis and the next responsible person, and the plan itself must not be treated as an executed result.

Services may take place in mental health centres, outpatient clinics, inpatient or residential facilities and private practice. The specific population, record system and work boundaries differ by institution, and the same job title does not mean the same conditions.

Addiction services may be coordinated with psychologists, psychiatrists, nurses and social workers. Cooperation requires clear duties and material access scope so that collaboration does not mean anyone can diagnose or obtain the complete record.

Training, internship, supervision, licensing and continuing education differ by direction and state. General communication ability, course completion and being able to practise independently are not the same proof, and preparation materials need each actual requirement checked item by item.

At a stage transition or at the end of a service there are still corresponding plans, records and resource arrangements. Completing one summary does not mean the service has ended or that the materials may be disclosed; work samples use only explicitly fictional input.

The following is divided into two editorial summary processes, plan progress review and resource linkage. They help in understanding the work object and output and are not a uniform clinical procedure or treatment steps that an individual can follow.
Plan and progress review
Clarify the duties → Understand the need → Agree on goals → Provide the service within authority → Record changes → Supervisory review
A plan progress record that distinguishes the goal, what has happened, the unknown status and the responsible person
Resources and stage linkage
Confirm the need → Check the resource → Determine the information scope → Coordinate arrangements → Confirm the status → Keep the handover
A linkage record stating the resource, the reply status, the date to be confirmed and the responsibility for the next step
Shared professional foundation
Active listening · source checking · plan review · progress records · team division of work · privacy and licensing
What problem does the plan progress record and what problem does resource linkage each solve?

The former focuses on whether the goal, the service that has occurred and the changes correspond, while the latter focuses on whether the need can be linked to an applicable resource and the current contact status. They support each other, but sending a contact must not be treated as receipt, and being able to organize text does not mean taking on professional treatment judgment.
Core purpose
Within the corresponding professional duties, assist with substance abuse or behavioural problems and review the goals and service progress.
Within the corresponding professional duties, assist with mental health, emotional and relationship problems and keep recording the service progress.
Main basis
The person's expression, existing materials, addiction or behaviour related goals and professional feedback; trained personnel check the scope of application.
The individual, family or group expression, mental health related goals and professional materials; a diagnosis cannot be inferred from one symptom alone.
Work process
Understand the need, negotiate goals, provide the corresponding support, record changes and coordinate follow-up resources.
Understand the mental health and relationship needs, agree on service goals, provide the corresponding counselling and review changes.
Main output
A service plan, progress records and prevention or follow-up resource arrangements, keeping the source and the items to be confirmed.
Individual, family or group service records, goal review and the related linkage arrangements, with professional content recorded under authority.
Professional responsibility
The institutional division of work, training and local licensing together define the task, and private practice has its state licensing checked separately.
Usually requires the corresponding master's degree and internship preparation, and real practice is still checked against state licensing and the institutional scope.
Coordination method
May coordinate services with psychologists, physicians, nurses and social workers, each with their own professional judgment.
May coordinate with related professionals and resource institutions, with information sharing handled under the law and the real task scope.
Not directly interchangeable
The US BLS combined statistic does not prove that the two directions have the same training, and certainly does not equal a general Chinese qualification.
Shared communication and documentation ability does not replace target direction training; Chinese counselling, social work and medical responsibility are checked separately.
Key occupational judgments

First distinguish goal from outcome, personal account from record, and plan from confirmation status, then explain the next step. The following are editorial exploration questions and are not for screening real people, diagnosis or clinical decisions.
Does the new record really show that the original goal has been completed?
Can the summary point out what changed and which input supports it?
Has the resource application been sent, or has the receiving party confirmed the arrangement?
Which status or source does the professional feedback target?

Map the feedback to the original plan and the latest record, then revise the summary. Keep the old judgment, the change and the reason, and avoid polishing only the wording while keeping an unsupported completed status.
Which unconfirmed items does the next reader need to know?

State clearly which reply is currently missing and who continues to confirm it; do not add a date, approval or result yourself just because the handover is urgent. The material scope and receiving authority must be checked separately.
Which work at a stage transition still needs confirmation by the responsible staff?
Understanding｜Listening and needs checking｜Understand the expression, distinguish the personal account, existing materials and professional opinion, and confirm your own task scope.
Planning｜Goal and plan review｜Within the trained and licensed scope, develop, recommend or review goals with the relevant people and do not treat the plan as a completed result.

Service｜Individual, family and group communication｜Provide the service under the corresponding direction and institutional duties, attending to understanding and participation, and do not assume all directions use the same method.
Records｜Progress and stage documentation｜Record accurately what happened, the goal changes, the material sources and the arrangements to be confirmed.
Collaboration｜Resource and professional linkage｜Check resources and status with the responsible staff, each carrying the corresponding professional judgment and material responsibility.
Development｜Training, supervision and follow-up｜Accept professional learning and feedback and check the continuing education, licensing and stage linkage requirements.
Section title｜Environment and collaboration in counselling services

BLS lists settings such as mental health centres, outpatient clinics, residential facilities, hospitals and private practice. Most work is full time and part time is also common; inpatient or residential settings may require night and weekend arrangements, which must be checked with the specific institution.

Organizations and sites｜Mental health centres, community organizations, hospitals and private practice have different conditions and tasks. The historical Chinese anti-drug social work announcements describe an adjacent post only and are not used to describe all mental health counselling settings.

Materials and tools｜Expression and records, goal plans, resource information, status feedback and professional discussion materials are common inputs. Electronic systems and office tools help organize, but owning tools does not confer diagnostic or practice authority.

Organization｜Individual, family, partner and group services vary by direction and may take place in a professional team. The record should distinguish personal opinion, professional judgment and items confirmed by the team.

Scheduling and stress｜Continuous contact with difficult situations, workload and resource limits may cause stress. The actual number of service users, shifts and recovery arrangements must be asked of the institution; no uniform daily caseload is written and no guarantee of an easy job is given.

Team communication｜At handover, state the goal, the current record, the replies not yet received and the next responsible person; do not hide the real status behind vague wording such as already handled.

Review and responsibility｜The service plan and progress need review by trained personnel under their duties. The crisis tasks in the occupational description do not mean the reader can carry out real crisis judgment or clinical handling.

Quality requirements｜The information source and status are clear, the goal and changes are traceable, and expression is respected and authority clear. A fluent summary does not prove the service works; real training, supervision and professional evaluation are still needed.
Professional basis and jurisdictional boundaries
The BLS OOH supports the duties, environment, education and licensing differences of the three directions.
O*NET21-1011 and 21-1014 respectively support the subdivided tasks; occupational interest is not a uniform individual result for everyone.
The three historical Chinese anti-drug social work announcements support the conditions and disclosed pay of an adjacent post and cannot represent the national occupational picture.
China's Mental Health Law sets the corresponding personnel and institutional scope for counselling, diagnosis and psychotherapy.
The HHS Part2 overview applies to specific US addiction service programs and records and does not cover all counselling records globally.

The US combined category covers addiction, behavioural problem and mental health counselling support, including plan review, progress records, resource referral and professional coordination. The specific work is defined by direction, training, state licensing and institutional division of work; work in China requires separate checks of law and post identity.

The US profile for clinical and counselling psychologists includes psychological assessment and the corresponding professional services and requires separate training and licensing, which is not obtained automatically from experience in the three counselling types.
Marriage and family therapists focus on professional services for partner and family relationships, with the tasks, education and licensing checked separately.
Rehabilitation counsellors coordinate resources around independent living, employment barriers and rehabilitation plans and cannot serve as a general resource introduction.

Mental health and substance abuse social workers focus on case management, resources and social support; the on-site frozen name of mental health and substance abuse worker must be understood together with the English identity.

paragraphs: Substance abuse and behavioural disorder direction
Provide addiction or behavioural problem support, plans and progress records under the corresponding duties.
A direction within the SOC21-1018 combined category, with education, state licensing and institutional scope checked separately.
Willing to listen, keep following up and understand the training requirements of that direction.
Mental health counselling direction
Provide individual, family or group mental health counselling, plans and progress review within the professional scope.
Also within this page's combined category, usually requiring a master's degree and internship and checks against the mental health state licensing; it is not a uniform exchange without training.
Willing to learn about the mental health professional tasks and the corresponding study and supervision.
Clinical and counselling psychologists
Moving to professional psychological assessment and services; ordinary counselling experience must not be treated as a psychology licence.
Check the education, supervised practice and licensing requirements for the target profession.
Marriage and family therapists
The focus shifts to professional services for partner and family relationships; being good at communication does not mean having training in that direction.
Willing to add the professional preparation for relationship services and check the licensing.
Rehabilitation counsellors
Centred on independent living, employment barriers, rehabilitation plans and resources, not a simple job introduction.
Willing to learn the professional tasks around personal goals and real barriers.
Mental health and substance abuse social work direction
Focuses on case management, social resources and service coordination; the on-site frozen name is understood together with the English.
Check the social work field of study, the institutional identity and the duties; a counselling title does not allow automatic transfer.
How should the directions within the combined occupation and the adjacent occupations be compared?

First separate this page's two directions, substance abuse and behavioural disorder and mental health, then look at the separate identities of psychology, family therapy, rehabilitation and social work. The US BLS combined statistic does not mean the training, service methods and licensing are the same, and Chinese job conditions are checked separately.

Use the F1 plan progress check to observe detailed record-keeping habits, then choose study according to the target task. A preference for communication or collaboration is not enough to prove professional competence; changing direction or moving to an adjacent occupation requires the corresponding training, licensing and real output.

The two internal directions are based on BLS and the two O*NET profiles, and the four adjacent occupations on their separate task profiles. Stable IDs and the actual frozen target names are kept; the selection signals are editorial suggestions, not a promise of transfer or hiring.
After choosing a direction, distinguish tool drafts, actual institutional adoption and employment causation, and do not expand professional authority.

Editorial exploration can use explicitly fictional plan and progress records to test draft organization: mark the old goal, the latest record and the arrangements still to be confirmed, then check sentence by sentence. Being able to write a summary does not obtain evidence of clinical effect, time saving or institutional adoption; handling real health materials requires separate checks of authority and law.

Plan review, resource information organization and professional counselling judgment are different responsibilities. A tool can propose text to be checked but should not decide a real diagnosis, treatment, crisis risk or that a service has been completed.

Evidence gap: this round obtained no representative AI adoption rate or net time-saving study for the SOC21-1018 combined counselling occupation. The two O*NET subdivided tasks, the ILO abstract and the NIST framework do not prove actual institutional benefits.

First determine which documentation needs checking, then confirm the usable materials and the reviewer. Career exploration uses only the fictional records on this page and does not infer from convenient organization that a real system is already authorized.
The BLS and O*NET records and plan tasks describe what people must be responsible for, not a validation that a particular model can safely carry out the same professional work.

The professional tasks in the US occupational description do not confer diagnostic or treatment authority in China, nor allow arbitrary upload of cases. Exploration is limited to fictional text, and real tasks are checked against the institutional division of work and the local law.

The responsible staff still check whether the goal has changed, whether the records are enough to support the status, which replies are still missing and who continues the handover. A generated completion statement cannot replace evidence that it actually happened.

Evidence gap: this round obtained no net job change for the three counsellor types attributable to AI. The EP combined growth of 18.4% includes many factors and can neither prove that AI has no effect nor be split into an AI substitution rate.

The ILO public abstract is a cross-occupational potential exposure study only. The complete occupational score table was not checked this round, so no score, adoption rate or unemployment probability can be filled in for SOC21-1018 or its subdivided directions.
How does AI take part in documentation drafts, and which responsibilities still need human confirmation?

Separate draft quality, institutional adoption, professional service outcomes and employment change. Organizing a fictional plan status is an editorial idea; public tasks and a general framework do not prove clinical safety or a substitution ratio, and without a reliable own-occupation task-level score no value is filled in.

The evidence below describes potential task change, real occupational tasks, employment projections and risk principles respectively. The source levels differ, and being able to generate text cannot be pushed into being able to take on service responsibility independently.
Public abstract of cross-occupational potential exposure and task transformation
Only the public abstract was checked, and the complete combined occupational scores were not; this does not equal actual adoption or a professional effect.
The BLS plan, record and resource tasks of the three counsellor types
A task description does not constitute a model clinical validation or a material processing licence.
The O*NET21-1011 and 21-1014 subdivided record and collaboration tasks
The two profiles describe the human duties of different directions, not all people in the combined occupation doing the same tasks.
Without institutional adoption and causal comparison, a task list cannot be used to infer that tools have replaced staff.
US SOC21-1018 combines substance abuse, behavioural disorder and mental health counsellors; the 2025 base period and the 2025–2035 overall projection, not split by a single direction.

BLS2025–2035 US SOC21-1018 combined substance abuse, behavioural disorder and mental health counsellor overall projection: 2025 base period 533,400 people, 2035 end period 631,400 people, an official net increase of 98,000 people, growth of 18.4%; the annual average of 50,500 openings includes transfers out and replacements and is not net growth or current recruitment. Headcounts are converted from thousands to preserve the original table precision, and the projection population differs from the wage and salary population; it cannot be split into a single counselling direction statistic, an AI causal substitution rate, a China projection or an individual probability of job loss.
The US combined projection is not Chinese demand or an individual hiring probability, nor does it prove that AI caused the growth.
General AI reliability and privacy risk framework
NIST supports checking the input, output and use environment; the status check on this page is an editorial application.
A voluntary framework is not a clinical guideline and provides no adoption, accident or unemployment ratio for this occupation.
Can a tool organize fictional plan and progress summaries?

You can write it yourself first, then use the tool draft as a comparison to be checked. Check whether an old goal is written as completed and whether new feedback and unknown replies are omitted; it can only show performance on this text task and does not prove real clinical adoption.
Does potential occupational exposure equal actual unemployment?

No. Potential task change, adoption and net job change are at different levels, and the ILO public abstract cannot give this page's occupational substitution rate. There is no complete occupational score basis this round, so no value is filled in.
Can resources in place in a draft serve as linkage confirmation?

No. In F1, Q1 sent an enquiry, and although Q2 has replied it explicitly states that personal service has not yet been arranged; assertive draft wording cannot add an arrangement confirmation, and certainly cannot write the material checking work sample as a real service already provided.
Can the US professional task description serve as a basis for practice in China?
How many combined-category counsellor jobs will AI reduce?

Evidence gap: this round has no value for a net SOC21-1018 job change attributable to AI alone. The combined growth of 18.4% does not mean AI has zero effect, nor can it be split into individual or single-direction outcomes.
Does finding a public resource equal completing service linkage?

No. The resource conditions, the contact reply and the actual arrangement need confirmation by the responsible person. A generated list does not let a tool promise an appointment, professional judgment or a service effect on behalf of the institution.
Which conditions should be checked before actual use?

Check the task scope, the lawful basis for processing materials, the receiving and retention scope and the review responsibility. Exploration uses fictional input only; for real materials or unclear authority, go to the institutional responsible person first and do not treat an external chat as the record system.
Combined occupation tasks
Supports plan and record collaboration responsibility and does not prove a model's clinical effect.

Supports only potential change background; the complete occupational scores were not checked.

Work task: linkage

Used to check reliability and privacy, not a treatment guideline.

Evidence gap: this round obtained no nationally comparable wage distribution for this occupation in China. The three historical anti-drug social work announcements below are adjacent posts, explain their pay separately and set no national pay grade for this occupation.

When discussing pay, first check the job duties, the employing entity, monthly or annual pay, benefits, tax basis and probation period; belonging to the same drug rehabilitation service direction does not mean the tasks or wages can be compared directly.

An annual amount that includes five social insurances and one housing fund cannot be treated as cash take-home pay; a labour company contract and a direct employment contract must also be confirmed separately.

The three announcements are deduplicated by publishing unit and post category, giving three adjacent post samples. All application periods have closed and this is not current recruitment statistics, and the number of positions does not equal the number of independent employers. The 2025 pre-tax annual average wage for all employed persons in urban health and social work in China: 146,266 for non-private and 75,631 yuan/year for private units. The author references it conditionally for the health or social work service employer direction only, and the actual unit's industry must be checked; an anti-drug social worker job title does not automatically determine the employer industry. The two unit populations differ and the industry covers many occupations; it covers urban legal-person units with 5 or more people, includes individual tax, social insurance and housing fund deductions, and excludes self-employed and freelance workers; it is not this counselling occupation's median, starting pay or individual range, and the two are not merged into a single range.

A historical offer supports only that round's position; check the actual contract, scheduling and paid arrangements and do not infer national pay or current recruitment heat.

Evidence gap: this round obtained no study of the share of wage change in this occupation in China caused by AI. A documentation assistance idea and actual adoption and income change are explained separately, and the combined US projection is not used to fill the gap.

The US May 2025 annual wage median is 59,350 USD and the hourly figure is 28.53 USD; this is combined SOC21-1018 data for three counsellor types including mental health counsellors, and it is not split by a single direction.
The annual P10 is 38,940 USD with an hourly figure of 18.72; a lower position in the distribution, not a new-hire wage line or a statutory minimum wage.
The annual P90 is 97,590 USD with an hourly figure of 46.92; it is not a seniority-based guaranteed pay or a guarantee of a high annual salary for an individual.

OEWS excludes the self-employed and so on, and the wage and employment statistics have different coverage populations; headcounts must not be multiplied by the median to estimate total occupational income, and self-employed fees must not be written as employee wages.

BLS annual figures usually use a 2080-hour statistical conversion; this page reads the published annual percentiles directly to avoid recomputation from the rounded hourly rate. The statistical assumption does not guarantee individual paid hours or take-home income.

2025 combined occupation annual wage distribution
The annual P50 is 59,350 with an hourly figure of 28.53 USD; it includes mental health counsellors, matches this page's combined category and is not a separate value for any direction.
How should the annual wage percentiles and the covered population be understood?

The percentiles describe the combined occupation wage distribution, not a job grade, an education band or a clinical ability level. Real jobs also require checking the qualification, the tasks and the actual pay.
Check the state licensing, institutional duties, full-time or part-time status, pay unit, benefits and tax basis; a statistical value is not the current employer's offer.
Industry annual wage medians: SOC21-1018 combined data
The combined public and private hospital median is 63,310 USD/year; it is not the wage of all hospital staff or a separate 21-1011 value.
The outpatient mental health and substance abuse centre median is 58,750 USD/year; the industry covers three counsellor types.
The individual and family services median is 58,440 USD/year; the actual pay for different tasks and qualifications is checked separately.
OEWS does not include the self-employed; private practice fees, costs and personal income are listed separately, and practice licensing must be verified by state.
Which conditions are still needed to compare actual pay?
Check full-time or part-time status, scheduling, paid arrangements and benefits; a national median cannot guarantee an individual's annual take-home pay.
The combined statistics for three types cannot represent a single duty; check the counselling task, the training level, the licence and the pay unit.
Hospitals, outpatient clinics and residential facilities have different environments and scheduling; an industry median is not a specific institution's current offer.
Combined employment: base, growth and annual average openings

Both the wages and the employment are within the SOC21-1018 combined scope, including substance abuse, behavioural disorder and mental health counsellors. A single direction, a specific region or a causal AI effect cannot be split out of them; the annual average openings include replacements and are not net growth or an individual hiring probability.

Observe whether the whole need is heard first and then the original expression and the items to be confirmed are restated. Being good at giving advice does not mean listening continuously and respecting different choices.

Use F1 to check the plan against the latest record: P1 only reads the goal, N1/N2 records the two materials read and the summary, and the Q1 enquiry and the Q2 reply do not mean the service has been arranged. Write the source for each of the eight items and locate where the goal, the progress or the status was confused; overall intelligence or real clinical ability cannot be judged from one wrong item. Then explain the revision on the same task and observe how understanding and attention improved.

Reviewer A asks to compare the plan with the evidence of completion and reviewer B asks to separate enquiry replies from service arrangements. Keep at least two changes and the reasons for each and do not replace the actual revision with words such as more professional. When the opinion is vague, ask which input and status it corresponds to; accepting supervision also does not mean accepting tasks beyond authority.

When service progress, study or job-seeking results are unsatisfactory, first separate what can be improved in your preparation, the real conditions and the unknown reasons. Record one change and the next step, do not exaggerate experience and do not decide personal worth from a single result; professional work still requires continuous learning and recovery.

Check the real contact scope, scheduling, documentation burden and supervision, then consider whether the real responsibilities can match. Some night and weekend arrangements in BLS do not mean every institution is the same.

Interest in helping, keeping documentation and accepting fluctuating progress are observed separately. One burst of enthusiasm does not show that you can bear the contact burden and professional responsibility long term.

Exploration needs no private experience of your own or real personal materials. Understanding others does not mean diagnosing their psychology, and removing the name does not automatically allow sharing the health record.

After completing it, see whether you can point out the misjudgments, explain the changes, keep the unknowns and respect the duties. A personality type and one test are not a substitute for educational licensing or professional preparation.

values: F1｜Five complete inputs and eight statuses

This task is entirely original fiction, with no real person or clinical service. P1: my exploration plan for this week is to read the public resource materials A and B and write a summary of each. N1: on Tuesday it is recorded that A was read and a summary written. N2: on Friday it is recorded that B was read and a summary written. Q1: on Thursday an enquiry was sent asking only about public application conditions, with no case materials. Q2: on Friday a reply was received: the application conditions must be checked first, and no personal service has been arranged. These are paper words and no resource needed to be read or contacted.

Eight items to be checked: (a) P1 plans to read two materials; (b) A has been read and has a summary; (c) B has been read and has a summary; (d) both summaries have records; (e) the public condition enquiry has been sent; (f) the institution has arranged personal service; (g) a professional assessment has been obtained; (h) all treatment goals have been completed. The deliberately wrong first version: the two summaries are complete, the institutional service has been arranged, and the professional assessment and treatment goals have all been completed.
F2｜Two-feedback revision and F3

Judge supported or unsupported item by item and write the P1/N1/N2/Q1/Q2 source, then write your own summary. Reviewer A's feedback: distinguish the original plan from the latest record and list when the goal has a basis for completion; reviewer B's feedback: separate sending the enquiry, receiving the reply and arranging the service, and keep the unconfirmed status. Reviewer A and B each require at least two revisions and reasons.

F3 records this page as original fiction, your own judgments and revisions, the actual AI role, no real case, paper work, and no sending or disclosure. Compare text only, and do not contact institutions, assess real people, design treatment or rehearse a crisis.
Answer key and the two versions of the summary

(a) supported by the P1 plan; (b) supported by N1; (c) supported by N2; (d) supported by N1 and N2; (e) supported by Q1. (f) unsupported, as Q2 clearly states nothing has been arranged; (g) unsupported, as the input has no professional assessment; (h) unsupported, as P1 is a reading exploration goal and there is no treatment goal at all. In total 5 supported and 3 unsupported. A supported record refers only to the input in this task and is not taken as real external verification.

Version A: the original plan was to read A and B and write a summary of each, and Tuesday's N1 and Friday's N2 respectively record the two readings and summaries, so the plan itself cannot be treated as evidence of completion. Version B clarifies further: the Thursday enquiry was sent and the condition reply arrived on Friday, personal service has not been arranged, and there is no basis for a professional assessment or completed treatment goals. The three overreaching conclusions are deleted, and an unknown is not turned into a refusal or a permanent impossibility. F3 records your own and the AI participation faithfully, and with no real materials it was not sent or disclosed.
Exercise boundaries

It tests the consistency of the plan, records, replies and revisions; it is not clinical training and includes no diagnostic screening, treatment, crisis role-play or real referral. Completing a reading goal cannot imply health improvement or a treatment effect; this task does not assess professional ability, licensing or passing recruitment.

description.text: Substance abuse, behavioural disorder and mental health counsellors form a US BLS combined statistical and occupational description category covering counselling support for addiction, behavioural problems and mental health. The actual work includes understanding needs, developing and reviewing plans, recording progress, coordinating resources and professional collaboration; the specific method, education, licensing and responsibility differ by direction, state and institution. Exploring the corresponding work in China requires checking the statutory boundaries of psychological counselling, social work and medical tasks separately.
